scope: Direct native duplicate-index write fault via canonical, deliberately injected no-action queue fixtures. No stateless admission, valid signature, proved Transfer or semantic negative-control credit.
registry: Complete correctly generated matching v2 registry05 only; no old v1/partial03. Native VK loader success required, PK decode/first-prove not exercised or credited.
build_and_run: Root alone: cargo test --locked --offline --profile ci -p shieldd-sdk-app --lib EXACT_TEST -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture
resource_policy: One guarded Cargo/test process at a time, cached build one thread, finite cap, direct validated host sampler, physical1.5GiB/commit512MiB reserves. No agent execution or reduced guards.
expected_observations: Actual put_block_transaction duplicate committed transaction error propagates through App end-block expect to an exact caught panic; first staged index insertion is unapplied.

Host remains InBlock because its interrupted-phase transition follows App end_block. Deferred queue is drained; durable committed state remains the original parent. Direct unsealed commit is rejected.

Same diagnostic Host instance can retry empty-queue end_block and seal/commit an empty indexed block. This is source branch behavior, not accepted Transfer loss or a security-positive retry assertion.
Explicit rollback reconstructs the old committed parent, clears pending/deferred state and returns Idle; a fresh empty block completes.

These Host unit controls do not instantiate QueryContext. Published-snapshot expectations remain unchanged until matching joint publication; reuse the separate native committed_queries_advance_only_after_joint_publication test for that API, without claiming it covers this injected fault.
remaining_genuine_controls: Actual accepted Transfer effects/ordered indexes under both PerTx and DeferredBatch using genuine correctly-generated matching-key proofs.
Source-owned one-shot flush write failure after genuine deliveries, exact pending/durable/published readback, consumer abort/rollback/reexecute trace.

A reachable consumer that retries after end-block panic must be demonstrated before declaring any accepted-block contract break. Retained Bankd PR351 source is architecture reference, not paired deployment qualification.
failure_policy: Compiler/loader/dependency/timeout/OOM/zero-tests/wrong panic cause are infrastructure or unrelated failures. They do not count as successful fault controls.
